articleTitle: Deep Learning for Oil Palm Fruit Ripeness Classification with DenseNet
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Oil palm fruit farming is one of the most leading agriculture industries in the South East Asia region. Unfortunately, most of the harvesting method is still done through manual labor. Multiple research has been conducted to help farmers automatically detect the ripeness level of the oil palm fruit. We conducted an experiment of detecting the ripeness level of oil palm fruit by using one of the state-of-the-art computer vision approaches, which was deep learning with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The dataset used consists of 7 levels of ripeness with 400 images of oil palm fruits. The models used in this test scenario were both AlexNet and DenseNet. The result of this study showed that DenseNet has been proven to outperform AlexNet by 8.5% in terms of accuracy and 8% in F1 score.

articleTitle: The Used of UTAUT-2 in Examining The Usage of Mobile-LMS Binus Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Raising students' awareness of adopting the mobile-LMS and motivating them to continue using the mobile-LMS is essential in distance learning. This study aims to analyze the UTAUT-2 factor in explaining behavioral intentions and actual use of mobile-LSM. Empirical data collection uses a questionnaire distributed to 500 BINUS Online Learning students with purposive sampling who have been using the mobile-LMS for more than one year. Data analysis using SEM-PLS with SmartPLS 3.3.3 software. This study confirms that performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, facilitating conditions, habit, and hedonic motivation positively affect behavioral intention. Likewise, facilitating conditions, hedonic motivation, habit, and behavioral intention positively affect the actual use of mobile-LMS. This research's conclusions become input for universities implementing distance learning programs to increase students' intention to adopt and continue to use mobile-LMS.

articleTitle: Expert System for Oil Palm Leaves Deficiency to Support Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Expert systems are an option in the implementation of agricultural cultivation, which can provide comprehensive information to make crop cultivation more precise. The expert program currently used in oil palm plants is still unable to provide accurate information on actual deficiencies. Thus, there is a need for an expert system that can provide valid information. This research creates an expert system in agriculture that can help farmers to make decisions by knowing the types of nutrient deficiencies in oil palm. Besides that, it can help the process of disseminating information and knowledge through applications that can be accessed at any time by farmers to save time and money and support their existence. Edge detection using the Sobel method and the Robert method using the High Pass Filter (HPF) is the basis for this expert system creation method. This expert system can be used for any type of mature oil palm plant where yellow spots are found, due to a lack of nutrients or deficiency. Diseases that arise due to deficiencies depend on each nutrient, in this study all deficiencies are specific to the upper part of the plant, namely leaves. Tests carried out 15 times resulted in the deficiency most often raised by oil palm trees due to the lack of primary essential nutrients, namely nitrogen nutrients. The validation assessment is then carried out by an expert (human) directly and assesses the deficiency directly, then from the results of the test and assessment, there are 11 images from 15 images that match the assessment by the expert.

articleTitle: Digital Art Technology Publication in Indonesia: A Bibliometric Analysis (2011-2020) Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Digital art technology is a form of technology in the form of hardware or software that can produce artistic works or practices as part of the creative process. This research is an idea about the publication of digital art technology, which shows its widespread use based on data from publications in Indonesia. This study visually maps scientific publications in digital techniques indexed with bibliometric analysis at the Indonesian state level. This study collected data from the Scopus database, used the Scopus website analysis feature, and visualized the bibliometric network using Vosviewer. The method used consists of five phases: search keyword determination, initial search results, search results refinement, preliminary compilation and data analysis. 57 academic documents published in Indonesia between 2011 and 2020 were obtained in the search for data based on the Scopus database. The processed data show patterns and trends in the increasing number of international publications in digital art technology indexed by Scopus. This study proposes a classification of the convergence axis.

articleTitle: A Propose Model Analysis of Investor Factors on Interests and Decisions of Using Online Investment Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Online investment applications are digital applications that support investors in investing, allowing investors to obtain information, sell and buy the investment products they want. In 2020, there will be a COVID-19 pandemic that requires all people to stay at home, and increasingly massive technological developments have increased internet users and users of online investment applications. The problem is that there is a loss from 2009 to 2019, reaching 29 trillion rupiahs caused by various problems, one of which is a fraudulent investment. This study uses literature studies from various journals. This study results from the factors of investor acceptance of online investment applications using the UTAUT2 method as the basis for the theory. The variables used are Facilitating Conditions, Hedonic Motivation, Performance Expectancy, Effort Expectancy, Social Influence, Price Value, Habit, and adding additional variables Perceived Risk, Trust. as well as Awareness-Knowledge.

articleTitle: Recommendation System based on Recognition of Prior Learning to Support Curriculum Design in Online Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Based on the policy of independent study and independent campus, where students can participate in part of the study period and load from within the campus, as well as others outside the campus, so that they can complete all periods and study loads as needed qualification is determined by the study program conducted through assessors. and this requires a variety of processes and takes a lot of time. For this reason, an alternative technique is needed to conduct an automatic Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) assessment through the application of a recommendation system. The purpose of this research is to find out how the recommendation system approach is used to predict RPL assessments and provide support for curriculum development in tertiary institutions that can meet the learning needs of the digital community. This study has succeeded in classifying learning outcomes based on independent assessment data of prospective students and can provide recommendations for curriculum development in colleges that organize online learning. This study proves that the use of a recommendation system using deep learning in the RPL assessment has an accuracy (97,24%) and is relatively the same as the assessor's assessment.

articleTitle: Technological Capabilities and Value Chain of The Foreign Firms in Indonesia’s High-Tech Industries
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The main focus of this research is to examine whether acquiring external technological capabilities and internally developed technological capabilities increase value chain of the foreign firm within Indonesia’s high-tech industries context. Foreign firms usually have better resources in term of technology, human resources and capital, in order to develop technological capabilities internally by increasing their ownership. On the other hands, foreign firms may also access to available technology, innovation and new method in the market by paying amount of royalty. Based on resource-based theory, this research argues that royalty and foreign ownership will contribute to increase value chain of the firms. Using ordinary least square (OLS) with Stata software, results show that contribution of technological capabilities have different effect on value chain for both chemical & pharmaceuticals firms and motor vehicles & other transport equipment firms. Acquiring external technological capabilities has increased value chain of the firms in these 2 types of industries. Meanwhile, internally developed technological capabilities has decreased value chain of the firms in chemical and pharmaceuticals industries but it has increased in motor vehicles & other transport equipment industries. The implication of this study is to provide the insights that the effect of technological capabilities on firm’s value chain depends on the characteristics of industries. For chemicals & pharmaceuticals industries, dominant foreign ownership provides greater flexibility to develop resources so that it has its own capability to compete and have the option of not getting involved in the value chain. For motor vehicles & other transport equipment industries, Indonesia’s firm played more of a role as upstream producers, where the products are produced to support other industries.

articleTitle: Traditional Mask Augmented Reality Application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The industrial revolution 4.0 has become a challenge for various sectors in mastering information technology, one of which is the arts and culture sector. Cultural arts that are quite widely spread and developed in Indonesia are traditional masks. Traditional masks are one of the oldest and most beautiful cultures in Indonesia. However, with the development of the era to the digital world in the era of the industrial revolution 4.0, this beloved culture is fading due to the entry of foreign cultures and technological developments. Many young people who succeed the nation do not understand this cultural art, namely traditional masks. So those cultural arts such as traditional masks can still keep up with the development of digital technology in industry 4.0, we conduct research to use technology to preserve this traditional mask culture. The research uses the ADDIE method starting with Analyze, Design, Develop, Implement, and Evaluate. We took some examples of traditional masks such as Malangan masks, Cirebon masks, and Panji masks from several regions in Indonesia. This research implements marker-based Augmented reality technology and makes a traditional mask book that can be a means of augmented reality.

articleTitle: Database Management System Design for Automatic Weather Information with Twitter Data Collection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Improvement of data management about weather in Indonesia is very supportive of the need for weather information. Currently, the weather information that is disseminated to the public is only based on sensor location points that are spread across Indonesia. However, supporting data generated from these sensors is only limited to certain areas. We hence develop a database system that can help collect weather information automatically via Twitter. This facilitates the Indonesian people in knowing weather information based on the completeness of data from sensor data and Twitter. The steps from the database that are built will be very helpful in collecting data about the weather throughout Indonesia. The basic step that we use in our database are conceptual, logical and physical design. The information obtained in this study is very important for efficient and effective data collection to achieve real-time automation of weather information.

articleTitle: Analysis of Product, Product Delivery Service, and Product Assurance in e-Commerce on Purchase Intention during the COVID-19 Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic impacts all aspects, including e-commerce. In Indonesia, social restriction creates a limitation to the customer in shopping activities. The traditional way of shopping generally requires actual products that must be seen and held, but this is an obstacle during COVID-19 pandemic conditions. Therefore, this research tries to explore the relationship of Product (P), Product Delivery Service (PDS), Product Assurance (PA) to Purchase Intention (PI). The quantitative research using Linear Regression to look for the relation of the factors. Four hundred seventy-one of e-commerce customer samples used in this article, the respondents are people who use the e-commerce to buy the product. Data collection using snowball sampling technique process. The SPSS application facilitates data processing. This article shows that product and product assurance has a relation to the purchase intention factor. However, the product delivery service has no relationship to purchase intention during the COVID-19.

articleTitle: Usability Testing of Vocabulary Game Prototype Using the Nielsen's Attributes of Usability (NAU) Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: A prototype of vocabulary game was developed for student who wants to learn English. With this application, user can play various game while learning English. The prototype was evaluated through usability testing to access its learnability, efficiency, memorability, error, and satisfaction. In the end, it was found that vocabulary game learnability rate was 74,4%, efficiency rate was 82,3%, memorability rate was 84,1%, error rats was 49,5%, and lastly 80,2% for satisfaction. Method used in this research was literature study carried-out includes material of User Interface, Usability Testing, and Nielsen’s Attribute of Usability Model tested using SEM, Smart PLS as statistic tools. Then from 47 respondents, who were asked to use the interactive UI, they had to run Usability Testing and answered the Post-Test Questionnaire. The result found that 2 hypotheses rejected and 3 hypotheses accepted.

articleTitle: Tracing of Spare Parts Replacement to Improve the Usage of Genuine Parts with Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The problem of counterfeit vehicle parts is something that is still happening today. Various techniques facilitate to prevent counterfeit spare parts in the market. One of many vehicles distributed is a vehicle repair shop—the previous study, stating that blockchain technology can trace and track spare parts. However, in previous studies, the model or method of implementation had not been found. Therefore, this research tries to simulate replacing replacement parts in the Blockchain to make it easier to track. This qualitative research involved a workshop for field observations and discussions with experts in related fields. In this study, a simulation is carried out directly of vehicle parts recorded in blockchain-based (multichain) applications. The results of this study indicate that Blockchain technology possible use for recording vehicle parts.

articleTitle: Introduction to Mask Malangan with Augmented Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Indonesia has a diverse culture, but nowadays the demand for it is decreasing. This is because the method for introducing culture is less attractive. By using Augmented Reality, the introduction of culture becomes more interesting. So that it can increase interest in learning about existing cultures. The concept of augmented reality is inspired by Malang mask tourism. We use Malang masks because we see the potential of users so that it makes it easier to introduce them. The process of making augmented reality is to create 3d assets on 3d paint, we try make 2 assets as a first step. followed by designing a prototype design using Figma. the last step is to use unity to combine all aspects and start making AR based on face recognition. we use the AR kit face tracking package to help detect faces. We also provide history and music background to introduce more Malang masks. Our application uses the base android. After exporting to android, we do tests based on distance and angle, and the result is our AR mask appears under certain conditions.

articleTitle: Digital Literacy Approach in Food Delivery Service Application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Purpose digital platforms have been so useful through pandemics. Many new applications are popping up in support of people running their daily lives. Specially to meet the needs of food and beverages. Thus, existing applications must be able to meet the needs of the community, and easy to understands as the literacy contained in the food delivery service application. The goal of this study is to learn more about the literacy approach utilized in Food Delivery service applications as well as its influence on intention to use. Design/Methodology/Approach. This research is quantitative. The population taken is the entire community of Go-Food application users in the Jakarta area, and sampling techniques using purposive sampling. Analysis techniques used are Structure Equation Modelling-Partial Least Square. Findings. The results of this study stated that digital literacy in the community in using food delivery service applications will affects customer intention to use this application. Originality. The impact of digital literacy on food delivery application to intention to buy from the customer.

articleTitle: The Heron Formula Approach for Head Movements Detection for Student Focus Detection during Pandemic Online Class
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Head movement are widely used and utilized, there are many things that applying head movement as a main subject such as to control a device, control a smart wheelchair, playing games and many more. In this study, we propose a preliminary study to use the head movements as a focus detector for student in online learning. We use several approaches such as Face Landmark until Heron Triangle approach to detect and recognize the movement of the head. In this study, we utilize the Heron formulas to obtain the large of triangle that shaped using the marking point from Face Landmark method. By using the large of triangle, this proposed method could obtain and recognize the gaze of head movements. Our proposed method can reach 85% of accuracy and has an ability to detect the horizontal and vertical movements. This study is an important as an initial step to create a robust head movement detection system especially for online learning purposes.

articleTitle: Developing Integrated Performance Dashboards with Power BI – a Case Study in a Medium-Size Manufacturer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Performance measurement system is essential for any organization to guide them optimizing their activities. For a small and medium size entities, the performance measurement system mostly exists but not integrated. The study is a case study in a medium size metal manufacturer producing metal-based parts and component for various industries. The research captured the performance measurement requirement from each division with interviews, studying company’s records, and participative observation. The result was visualized into inter-connected IDEF0 diagrams to ensure performance integration. The performance measurement system was then constructed from their existing excel worksheets into several visualized dashboards using Power BI.

articleTitle: Analysis of Product Trust, Product Rating and Seller Trust in e-Commerce on Purchase Intention during the COVID-19 Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has changed many things, including the way of shopping. There is an increasing number of internet users in Indonesia due to regulations on social restrictions where the number of people limits to schools, malls, offices, and shopping centers. This limitation also increases the number of e-commerce users. Several studies have also stated that the COVID-19 pandemic has changed the way people shopping. But the research conducted has not addressed the problem of the impact of customer trust on products, product ratings, and trust in sellers. Therefore, this research, which data collection was carried out at the time of the COVID-19 pandemic, with social distancing was still being implemented. This quantitative research uses 471 respondent data from users of one of the largest e-commerce in Indonesia, then the data is processed using linear regression techniques with the SPSS application that processes the data. From the research results, it is found that trust in the product, product rating greatly affects the purchase intention, while trust in the seller does not affect it. The results of this research are beneficial for future eCommerce development.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology for Vehicle Maintenance Registration
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Vehicle maintenance is done regularly by vehicle owners to maintain the best performance to avoid harmful effects, such as accidents. However, according to the news, counterfeit spare parts can easily found in vehicle maintenance workshops. Therefore, this study tries to use blockchain technology to record the vehicles for sparepart maintenance. Several previous studies have mentioned the benefits of blockchain technology that can carry out tracking and tracing in the automotive industry, but no discussion on the laboratory-based experiments to see how the implementation of blockchain technology for vehicle identification registration which in the future can be used for tracking components in vehicles. Therefore, this study simulates the recording of vehicle identities using a multichain application. This qualitative research was carried out by doing field observations and discussions with experts in related fields. The simulation results in the laboratory are shown to the expert as a discussion material for validation. From the validation results, it can be concluded that blockchain technology can be used to record vehicle identities, which can be developed for tracking spare parts in vehicles. This result is beneficial for business actors to improve the quality of vehicles.

articleTitle: Marketing Influencer: How to Measure Purchase Intention Using Social Media - Study of Confirmatory Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This study validates the influence of marketing instruments on a person's intention to buy social media customers. It is developed by two main factors: Advertising value (consisting of informativeness, entertainment), and Source credibility (consisting of trustworthiness, expert, attractiveness, and similarity). We took a random sample of 501 from various social media groups and followed at least one influencer. Statistical analysis is confirmatory factor analysis with Lisrel 8.7. The results of this study indicate that all measurement instruments developed have met the requirements of statistical instruments. The instruments developed can be used for further research that explicitly studies influencer marketing.

articleTitle: Acceptance of E-learning Implementation: Jakarta’s High School Students
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Nowadays information technology has been used in various aspects of life, one of it is in education industry. In education industry the usage of information technology to deliver learning is known as online learning or we usually call it as E-learning. E-learning is an education concept that used information technology in learning and teaching process. This study’s purpose is to examine and analysis the acceptance level of E-learning system in Senior High School Students in Jakarta using the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) method and then analyze all the data collected using the Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) - Partial Least Square (PLS) method. This result conducted to check and give recommendation regarding acceptance about e-learning that used in schools, especially in Senior High School in Jakarta. Roscoe method was used in this research and the maximum number of respondents were chosen to complete this research data. 500 respondents were asked to fill the questionnaire and all data had been collected by distributing questionnaires via online forms. This study’s result has proven that all hypotheses in this study have a positive and significant effect.

articleTitle: Key Success Factors for a Better User Experience in E-Commerce Website
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The trend of online shopping has increased e-commerce growth significantly over the years. The shopping habits are shifted from traditional shopping to online shopping, especially in the COVID-19 pandemic era. Therefore, a company is should not only concern about the products and services promotion but also offer the positive and high value to customers by providing a well-designed website. It was found that a well-designed website could create a positive user experience for the customers. The purpose of this paper is to define the key success factors for a better user experience in e-commerce website. With the systematic literature review approach, 43 key factors were found from 27 works of literature that the companies should focus on building their website.

articleTitle: The Antecedent Factors of Green IT
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Green IT thrives in industries that focus on environmental sustainability. However, currently green IT is starting to be implemented in the industry in general, so it is necessary to explain the concepts and indicators that explain green IT. Based on the phenomenon of green IT, this study aims to examine the antecedents of green IT and their impact on competitive advantage. The research was conducted through a survey of companies that focus on environmental sustainability in Indonesia. Data from companies is taken quantitatively through a questionnaire with a focus on examining green IT and competitive advantage. The results of the study found that there are several factors that can be used as measurements for green IT including procurement policy, storage consolidation, storage virtualization, server virtualization, managing electronic waste policy, and measuring the environmental impact. The implementation of green IT has a good relationship in supporting the achievement of the company's competitive advantage. Findings from the research can be used as information for companies in implementing green IT.

articleTitle: Application of Augmented Reality in The Adventure Kelana Application (Travel Agent)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This paper discusses the design of the Kelana Adventure application that applies AR or augmented reality technology. Kelana adventure is a mobile-based travel agency application that uses augmented reality as a superior feature in providing better visualization of tourist objects than various similar applications. This study discusses the methods used in designing applications and their steps in order to obtain a model / prototype that is as close as possible to user needs. From the method used, a mockup of the adventure rover application was formed to provide a visualization of the application layout. The results of the mock up will then become the standard framework for the development of the adventure rover application

articleTitle: Contemporary Studies of Task-Technology Fit: A Review of the Literature
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Information technology can influence task characteristics for the improvement of task performance. This review of the literature aims to explore the application of the TTF theory by exploring the scope and range of the available literature that applies the specific elements of the theory and summarizing and disseminating the research findings, specifically the environments where TTF has been applied. It was found that the education field is the most researched topic in TTF for the last three years, followed by social media, business, and management fields. Overall, the results of this study provide an understanding of applications of the theory and assists in providing avenues for future studies to investigate TTF studies further.

articleTitle: Examination of the Variables Affecting Customers’ Acceptance of Online Lending Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Online lending platform offer benefits for underserved segment that need access to loans. The massive development on this industry because of the convenient access compared to bank or multi finance. OJK as the authorities expect this industry can support financial inclusion in Indonesia. This study designs to identify the Variables Affecting Consumers’ Acceptance of Online Lending Platform based on problems and opportunities. Variables related to opportunities are Familiarity and Interest Rate, while variables related to problems are Trust and Security. This study’s sample size determination method using estimation of a proportion, unit analysis is the individual customers, sampling technique using simple random sampling processed 145 respondents and processed the data using PLS-SEM. The results are Familiarity affects the acceptance of online lending platform. This research also produces recommendations for the development of the industry so it can support financial inclusion.

articleTitle: Applying QR Code in Mobile Banking Use
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The QR technology has changed the payment industry especially in retail market. More and more companies introduce their easy payment through QR payment. The fast penetration in the market has made QR payment become necessary payment for major SME industries to survive in the market. QR payment has become essential substitution to current cash or debit card payment. Although QR payment has convenience experience, it poses to security threats associated with its system design. Many mobile applications still have many difficulties to balance to adopt its benefits and managing threats. The article takes case study of a well-known banking mobile banking application in applying QR system. The outcome of the article is expected to provide reference for mobile application to apply QR system.

articleTitle: Issues and Determinant Factors of Customer Feedback on E-Commerce (e-marketplace)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Feedback on e-commerce (e-marketplace) is popular nowadays, this way can help customers to buy products or services efficiently. With the increasing use of e-commerce (e-marketplace) the feedback given also various. So, it is important to find out what is the factors that influence a customer to give feedback on e-commerce (e-marketplace). This research uses a systematic literature review approach to answer the research question "what are the issues of giving feedback on e-commerce (e-marketplace)" and "what factors influence customers to give feedback on e-commerce (e-marketplace). With the systematic literature review approach, 43 key factors were found for the customer influence while giving feedback to e-commerce (e-marketplace) from 50 article papers. Also, the top 3 issues that need to be focused on the most are lack of information, no trust, and fake ratings, while the 3 most factors are information usefulness, trust, and perceived risk.

articleTitle: Implementation of ERP Sub-Module Account Payables System on Purchase Transaction of Heavy Equipment Spare Parts
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The research goal was to identify, analyze the user requirements, and implement information systems, especially on sub-module accounts payables in the invoice collecting process at Company. The implementation process using Accelerated SAP (ASAP) methodology includes 5 stages: project preparation, business blueprint, realization, final preparation, go-live & support. The analysis is done on the ongoing business process, which is described with the activity diagram, then the analysis result is the documentation of the implementation process of account payables system that can assist the invoice collecting process activities and generate reports according to the needs of the company.

articleTitle: The Effect of Online Learning Technology on Learning Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This article supposes to elaborate and examine the effect of online learning technology on the learning effectiveness. The qualitative study was conducted by using Google Form as the online questionnaires for collecting data. The study successfully involved participation of 250 students at Bina Nusantara University as the respondents. Collected data was analyzed by using IBM SPSS. The results found that there is a strongly relationship and influence between online learning technology and learning effectiveness. During COVID-19, dramatic changes in learning approach does not make effectiveness of learning declined or disrupted. Online learning technology what is provided by institution support student learning effectively as well as on-site learning. This article contributes to empirical facts in Human-Machine Interaction (HCI) which strengthen the argument that technology becomes an antecedent of learning effectiveness.

articleTitle: Concept Model: Analysis of Factors on Intention and Decisions on the Use of Smart Tourism Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Technology is evolving so fast that it reaches the tourism sector. The influence of technology is using smartphones to access information about destination tourism destinations in a smart way. Therefore, this study aims to understand the factors that influence psychologically that provide a basis for a person to have a user's intention to adopt and use the application when traveling in search of destination tourist destinations. The method used is using literature studies in reputable database articles or journals from Scopus, science direct, IEEE explore, etc. This study finds the Extended Unified Theory of acceptance and use of technology (UTAUT2) as the basis for adding trust and risk variables. The variables used are based on existing theories, so this study uses the variables Facilitating Conditions, Hedonic Motivations, Performance Expectancy, Effort Expectancy, Social Influence, Price Value, Habit, Trust, and risk. This variable can also play a role in helping to analyze factor influence to use smart tourism application, and promotional activities are carried out by developing smart tourism applications effectively and dynamically later.

articleTitle: Overview of Tourism Digital Model: General Factors and Variables
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Tourism continues to be developed, as one of important sectors to support foreign exchange revenue and also support the economic sectors. The purpose of this research finds the mapping factor from digital economy and its implementation in tourism sector as known as tourism digital model. The Methodology of this research used literature approach from previous research of digital economy characteristics factors and digital tourism. The results of this research were generated variable in Tourism Digital Model that can help develop and support in implementation of digital tourism.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Subsidy Claim System on The Cost of Product Purchase Packaging in Lazada Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Based on observations towards Lazada Indonesia there is a deficiency in the process of subsidy claims that exist in Lazada today. Therefore, this study is conducted to describe the process of claim delivery subsidy package that includes the process of subsidizing partner sales management, validation, and calculation of claims and evaluation/assessment of subsidy schemes based on the performance of sales partners to produce final calculation report that must be paid by the Lazada to the seller. Some problems encountered among others, there are still many manual processes, ranging from the process of sending invoice proof of delivery of the package by the sales partner until the validation made by Partners Support Lazada and final calculation of subsidized delivery by the finance Lazada. This research will use the analysis method and design of the information system by using the Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOAD) approach. The method of analysis is done through interviews, observation, and literature study. The conclusions obtained from the analysis and design done is an integrated system, can provide benefits for Lazada Indonesia, especially for the subsidy claim module. Efficient cost and time and accurate quality of the information in the process of claim validation and disbursement of claim funds provide maximum benefits for Lazada Indonesia and avoid any fraud committed by the partners in the business processes that occur within the company, due to the accuracy and suitability of claims data from the packet of goods is indispensable as reference for use in the next process.

articleTitle: A Systematic Literature Review on Factors Influencing Waste Management IT-Based Products Marketing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The use of social media is a tough challenge for the Waste Bank community to market its waste management products. Because no reliable research has yet been found that online marketing is able to have a significant and affirmative impact on the marketing of waste management products, the researchers conducted a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) research in analyzing and identifying various models and frameworks carried out in previous research on marketing. waste management products. The criteria used are to determine the search keywords, by determining the search page, search keywords and the year the journal was published. The keywords used include "waste management patterns", "market waste management products", "sales of IT-based waste management", "market IT-based products", "waste bank", and "bank sampah". Fourteen relevant papers were found and divided and provided in a matrix table to answer the research questions. From the data analysis and coding in SLR, it was found 5 factors inhibiting the marketing of waste management products, namely: IT understanding, management, introduction of waste management product branding, and waste management product marketing.

articleTitle: E-learning Community Model for SMEs
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: SMEs is one of the economic drivers of society whose existence is very helpful for the people's economy, especially the lower class. One of the main problems of SMEs that hinder the development of their business is limited knowledge and difficulty in increasing their knowledge. On the other hand, SMEs have strengths such as the SMEs community which can be used as a place to increase the knowledge of SMEs. The purpose of this paper is to help SMEs increase their knowledge of SMEs through the SME community. The result of this research is a model used by the UKM community for the learning process.

articleTitle: Producing Design Solutions for Vocabulary Game Using User Centered Design (UCD)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: English as a foreign language is studied across the world, of course, includes Indonesia. The results, though, are still not as good as expected. Technologies are one of the tools in learning a foreign language. Gamification is one of the ways to learn English better. This paper tries to create design solutions with UCD to create the fairest game to learn vocabulary for users. This research collected data from 103 respondents in November 2020. The respondents were those who have used language learning applications. The respondent watched a video using the interactive User Interface (UI) of the application (prototype) before using it. The use of questionnaires was used to look for user's requirements. With the use of UCD, we specify the context of use, the user requirements, and the design solutions that exist; Landing page, leaderboard, badges, point systems, vocabulary builder, word's definition, and flashcards. This research aims to recognize the user's expectations and the User Interface based on the user recommendation.

articleTitle: Data Management 4.0 for Financial Service Authority (FSA): A Case Study in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Financial technology-based institutions have grown tremendously in the last five years. Due to its strong growth, Indonesian Financial Service Authority (FSA) such as OJK, has many difficulties to supervise their operations. Studies show many foreign financial technology-based institutions operate in Indonesia and earn many benefits from Indonesian customers. They may conduct illegal operation and many of them operate beyond the knowledge of OJK as a supervision body. For this reason, the article examines the importance of developing data management service that enables to equip FSA to easily supervise all financial institutions. so that all activities in the financial services sector are where Organized regularly, fairly, transparently, and accountably, Able to realize a financial system that grows in a sustainable and stable manner and Able to protect the interests of consumers and society.

articleTitle: Design of Employee Management Application for Small Medium Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Information technology has become the basis in various companies to support operations and management so that companies in various fields have begun to develop information technology within their companies to compete in their competition. By developing information technology in a company, it can increase the productivity of a company. The objectives of this research are: Designing applications for Small and Medium Enterprises such as calculating employee absences, leave, overtime, BPJS, PPh21 to assist Small and Medium Enterprises in managing employees, designing reports that can help SME owners to view employee data and monitor employee attendance/permission. The methodology used for designing this system was study literature, interviews with employees and small-medium enterprise owners, and System Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The benefit of this research is that it helps SME owners to view employee data and monitor employee attendance/permits.

articleTitle: Proposed IT Governance for Hospital Based on TOGAF Framework
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: IT Governance in Hospitals describe in what way to build an IT gov. method that growths the amount of IT developments that provision the plan of a hospital and are accomplished on schedule. Presently some hospital makes huge investments in the Information Technology but they do not know how to manage IT investments and ensure IT investments are in line with the development of hospital. Decent IT governance at Hospitals is projected to deliver enhancement on excellence, functionality, and comfort of use of the facility. TOGAF framework can be practical in conditions and can be used to appliance good Hospital IT governance. This research recommend Hospital IT governance base on TOGAF. In the grounding of the projected IT gov. model, the enablers that occur in TOGAF framework is used as a shaping factor. For accomplishment the improvement of IT to realize the institution dream base on a model of hospital IT governance.

articleTitle: Development of an Application for Tourism Route Recommendations with the Dijkstra Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The trend of tourism 4.0 has become one of the issues in tourism and implemented in many ways. Malang city, Kota Batu and Kabupaten Malang areas such as Kota Batu and Kabupaten Malang are well-known as Malang Raya. Tourist attraction can be found in Malang raya. Since there are so many tourist attraction places and scattered across Malang Raya, tourist needs to find the best path in order to visit as many places as possible. This research project is conducted to find and apply the algorithm of Dijkstra to give recommendation of shortest path to tourist interesting places. There are four considerations in this research including first attraction place that will be visited by the tourist, distance between attraction places, types of the attraction places and the nearest attraction places from the first attraction place. Methodology in this research consist of several steps, including identification of required parameters, analysis of recommendation systems, data gathering, data validation and analysis, system development based on Dijkstra Algorithm, implementation and evaluation of the recommendation system. The proposed recommendation system able to recommend shortest path in three to four seconds. It is hoped that this project able to provide a ready – to – apply recommendation system for tourist attraction places in Indonesian’s cities, especially in Malang City.

articleTitle: Applying TOGAF-based Cloud Adoption Framework
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Despite of its flexibility and scalability, many organizations still encountered challenges to successfully implement cloud solution. Migrating from legacy to cloud solution apparently required rigorous communication and coordination with cloud provider. TOGAF-based cloud adoption framework was designed to facilitate both the enterprise architecture and business strategy. This paper demonstrated how this framework was applied in a real case of cloud call center initiative. The step-by-step approach in this framework has assisted the project team to assess the extent of preparation effort, perform cloud solution selection process, and estimate the benefits to business.

articleTitle: User Experience Analysis of binus.ac.id Website with The Usability Testing Perspective (A Case Study Approach)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Nowadays student registration can be done via online as well as offline. Which is why university website is important and need to be clear, so the potential student or parent can acquire correct and complete information about the university. The author using BINUS university website as an object for this research. This research will use two online accessibility tools for gathering information such as quality assurance for the component of the website and load speed when user click the website. The goal for this research is to find any missing spot on the website, which is been ignore from the initiate of the website deployment. So, from the result of this research, it can give the website developer suggestion to reconstruct the website by improving the quality of user experience and this research become the lesson learned also for the researcher in area of user experience.

articleTitle: How CHAID-Based Rule Induction Algorithm Helps Managements of Tourism Sites Improve Tourists' Experiences
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to generate a set of hypotheses on dataset of tourists’ experiences resulted from CHAID-based rule induction processes. This study is particularly needed because the generated hypotheses can help managements of any tourism sites improve decision making processes on tourists’ experiences. Methodology in this study follows four major steps i.e. 1) data collection, 2) data cleaning, 3) CHAID processing, and 4) hypotheses generation based on rule induction. The result of this study is a set of hypotheses which can be in general adopted by managements of any tourism sites. However, tourism sites are so various and divergent in their types that the managements are suggested to modify and complement the dataset with their specific attributes to achieve a more relevant set of hypotheses to their sites. This study can be benefit of any businesses in the arena of tourism sites especially for winning the competition, increasing their level of competitive advantages or even for surviving in the arena.

articleTitle: Analysis the Factors that Affecting Online Loyalty in Sharing Transport to Achieving Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This study aims to determine what factors affect the achievement of sustainable development targets in sharing economic activities. The independent variables used in this study are online service quality, online satisfaction, and online trust. Meanwhile, the dependent variable used as a measurement is online loyalty. Online loyalty is assumed to reflect the sustainability of a company. With the sustainability of a company, it will have an impact on the achievement of sustainable development goals. Online transport has an interesting sharing economy concept to be the object of research, because online transport is expected to be a solution to urban congestion problems. The partial test results show that online satisfaction and online trust has an influence on online loyalty.

articleTitle: Analysis and E-CRM Design in ASC Company
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This research aimed to identify, analyze, and design an e-CRM system to support the business process at ASC company. The analysis method used SDLC waterfall and the design used UML diagram to create the web-based application system based on user requirements from ASC company. Then after the UML finished, the author started to make the user interface prototype that included online order, customer can check the prize or view the stock online, customer can check their order status there. The prototype was given to ASC company so they can develop the application.

articleTitle: Analysis of Chatbot Program Features Towards Customer Satisfaction in the Era of Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The development of the digital era today is very closely related to technological sophistication. Thus, today we can recognize the existence of artificial intelligence. Companies or organizations widely use artificial intelligence to maximize and optimize services to consumers. PT Asuransi Wahana Tata as a general insurance company, is also very aware of this. This study aims to determine the effect of chatbot services on customer satisfaction in this digitalization era. The research method used is quantitative. The data obtained from the questionnaire were analyzed using inferential analysis. Analysis of ASWATA's chatbot program. This study used a sample size of 339 consumers. For sampling, the author used probability sampling techniques as a technique for data collection. The author used the SEM method by processing the data from the questionnaire using the Warp PLS 7.0 application. Samples were taken from ASWATA consumers who had used the VANIA program at least once. The results of this study found that the entertainment indicator in the marketing effort variable got the highest loading factor value compared to the others. So it can be concluded that communicating with VANIA is very fun.

articleTitle: Evaluation Social Media-Based E-Government through Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The implementation of E-Government was happened because of various services such as simplify public services, interactive, and encourage people to listen to their aspirations. The government should facilitate the participation of public dialogue in the formulation of state policies. The research aimed to evaluate the user experience of LAKSA Application in Tangerang City Government by The Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) method, so it can know the influence of user behavior toward LAKSA application. Data were collected from questionnaires to 311 respondents in Tangerang City. Data analysis was done with Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) and using SmartPLS as data processing tool.

Author Keywords: the unified theory of acceptance and use of technology

articleTitle: The Impact of Satisfaction and Perceived Risks to Continuance Intention on Using Mobile Wallet & Pay Later
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This study aims to understand why mobile wallet users intend to continue using the mobile wallet and pay later for the payment system and find out whether the satisfaction and perceived risk have an effect or not on continuance intention in the mobile wallet. This research is motivated by increasing mobile wallets in Indonesia, especially in Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Tangerang, Bekasi, and Bandung. This research used Structural Equation Model (SEM) and SmartPLS as statistical tools, with purposive sampling for data collecting. Data were taken from October - November 2020. The proposed model has 5 (five) variables: Perceived Usefulness, Confirmation, Satisfaction, Perceived Risk, and Continuance Intention in Mobile wallets, and four hypotheses. All hypotheses have a significant impact.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Factors Affecting Using Interest of QRIS Payment Systems on E-wallet Applications in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to determine the impact of QRIS (Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard) on e-wallet ease of use, which affects user satisfaction, the impact of QRIS on e-wallet usefulness, which affects user satisfaction, the impact of QRIS on e-wallet perceived compatibility, which affects user satisfaction, and the impact of QRIS on user satisfaction, which affects the intention to use QRIS on e-wallet. This study employs quantitative methods, with 145 e-wallet application users in Indonesia serving as respondents. Measurements are made using Davis's Technology Acceptance Model, which has been modified to include five variables: Perceived Ease of Use, Perceived Usability, Perceived Compatibility, User Satisfaction, and Intention to Use. According to the research results, perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, and perceived compatibility all have a 61.6 percent impact on user satisfaction. Meanwhile, user satisfaction influences intention to use by 68.2 percent.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of CRM System for PT. Askrindo
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Marketing is vital in the process of selling the company's products. Based on the interview results, the CRM system at PT Askrindo has several problems that include a lot of redundant data, the number of users who use the CRM system has not reached 100%, and there is a mismatch in CRM system reports with the financial information from the company. This research aims to identify problems, analyze needs, and design new prototype CRM websites to provide solutions to companies to solve the issues. The process of creating CRM is carried out by prototyping the model method. The new proposed system has core features related to marketing business processes in addition to key account structure. The proposed system separates roles in marketing and customers to fit the condition of the new marketing division structure. The result of the proposed CRM application shows a promising system in helping the marketing department in this company.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Analysis on E-Government and Tourism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: E-Government and Tourism are fields of research that are constantly evolving. Where tourism services are one of the major foreign exchange earners for most countries. Governments in various countries are trying their best in providing services by utilizing information technology. The purpose of this research is to find out and map the scientific publications that have been carried out on the topics of e-government and tourism indexed by Scopus scientific publications, published from 2000 to 2020. So that research trends in this field can be seen and provide insights for further research. This research uses the bibliometric analysis method. Results showed that the most cited research topic was the recommendation system topic with 639 citations, the country that contributed the most documents was China and the most affiliated contributors were Georgia College & State universities and Sydney University of Technology with each producing four articles. This study also contributes to knowledge by proposing classification characteristics of egovernment and tourism with the theme: Websites, Applications, Services, and Electronics. This characteristic abbreviated as WASE.

articleTitle: Scrutinizing the Effect of Digital Mastery on Learning Agility in Palm Oil Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This article, based on this research, aims to examine the effect of digital mastery on learning agility in the Indonesian palm oil industry, as the basic skills needed to achieve sustainability in the Indonesian palm oil industry; especially in responding to business progress and increasing competition. This is based on a cross-sectional study involving 277 supervisors and managers of private plantation companies in Sumatra and Kalimantan. Structural equation modeling approach was used to analyze the collected data. The results of the study explain that digital strategic skills have a significant and complete impact on all dimensions of learning agility. Meanwhile, communication skills and digital content creation only have an impact on people and agility of results.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Patient Information System Cloud Base Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The increase in Covid-19 patients with various levels of severity made the government experience difficulties in accurately knowing the number of Covid-19 patients. Reporting on a platform from the region to the center with an ineffective process makes it difficult to obtain accurate Covid19 patient data. In addition, the unavailability of an information system that integrates all parties involved who can provide information on the development of Covid-19 disease data further complicates the problem, especially problems related to the quality of information on Covid-19 patients. This research aims to help the government get quality information about Covid-19 patients in Indonesia. Indonesia. The result of this research is a cloud computing-based Covid-19 patient information system model.

articleTitle: Conceptual Design of Polygenic Risk Score Web Portal
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The paradigm of polygenic risk score (PRS) has recently been getting much wider attention. PRS is a mathematical aggregate reflection of the risk conferred by deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) variations to estimate the susceptibility of people to some certain onset of diseases. It is enumerated by summing risk alleles which are weighted by effect sizes in a large population derived from genome-wide association study (GWAS) where the gene variations are reproducible in different sets of GWAS. The emerging of direct-to-consumer genetics testing has tremendously increased access to genetics testing for broader users. The result of this genetics testing can be used as a disease predictive tool. One of the applications is PRS. PRS is a mathematical aggregate reflection of the risk conferred by DNA variations to estimate the susceptibility of people to some certain onset of diseases. However, the accessibility of these heavy statistics and mathematical models is limited to certain groups such as physicians and researchers. The objective of this study is to propose a conceptual design of web based PRS calculation available for public users. The users can maximize the utilization of their genotype data as a predictive tool for various disease risks. The design presented in this paper including the proposed class diagram, use case diagram, user journey diagram, and a series of user interface mock-ups. This result can be used as a prototype to gain users’ feedback before implementing in production stage.

articleTitle: Database Management System Design for COVID-19 Symptom Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Applying a digital strategy is proven to be one way to reduce the infection rate of COVID-19. As a fundamental part of it, database is capable to create a data repository to predict uncertain impacts of the pandemic. The research proposed a database design for project C-Beta that emphasized on creating an ideal system to record and monitor the daily health condition of people with COVID-19. Mainly, the research adopted Connolly and Begg principles of Database Software Development Life Cycle. As a result, the database design activities produced blueprints in the forms of data dictionary, ERD, and user views. The database design delivered in the research included with several features namely user verification, restricted research membership, and flexibility in survey creation. Based on analysis and design phase, C-Beta provides a method to collect data for COVID-19 clinical study. Researchers who utilize C-Beta is able to manage multiple surveys and extract all collected records at the same time.

articleTitle: Geographical Information System Model for Covid-19 Patient
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The increasing number of Covid-19 patients causes an increase in the need for care for Covid-19 patients which also increases. The need for drugs, treatment rooms, medical personnel available at the hospital is important information that must be updated because an increase in Covid-19 patients hospitalized will reduce the availability of the number of health facilities available so that the government can take strategic actions to manage all resources necessary health facilities. The problem found was that information on health facilities resources such as treatment rooms, medicine, medical equipment, Covid-19 patient information and regional government data were not well integrated, making it difficult to update information based on changes in data in the field. The purpose of this research is to build a geographical model of the COVID-19 patient information system that integrates information resources on health facilities and regional areas. The GIS concept is used in research outputs to facilitate management in obtaining spatial information for policy making and strategic decisions related to handling Covid-19 patients. The result of this research is a GIS model for Covid-19 patients.

articleTitle: Adapt Business Challenges in The 4.0 Industrial Revolution Through a Marketing Strategy (Case Study at PT.XYZ)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: In line with the development of systems and technology in the current industrial revolution 4.0 era, where the platform is implemented in the business sector, the role of the customer becomes the focus of the company's morning business, so it is necessary to look for factors, indicators that influence competitive advantage, so that models can be built evaluation to implement an effective Customer Relationship Management system to solve problems that arise in the company in terms of increasing customer loyalty and satisfaction. The method used is the method of data collection by conducting interviews and distributing questionnaires to various parties involved by using the Customer Relationship Management Value Chain theory as a conceptual framework and the method of data analysis of the results of the questionnaire using the factor analysis method. The results of data processing obtained several new factors and also constituent indicators of these factors and an ideal evaluation model can be built. It can be concluded that the factors associated with evaluating the implementation of Customer Relationship Management are Customer Service Experience, Customer Experience Value, Business Value Proposition, Product Development and Communication Core, and Lack of Services and Supply, so that through these factors models can be built for implementation the right and relevant industrial revolution 4.0 platform for customers.

articleTitle: The Use of Instagram in Creating Brand Equity of Nosh Kitchen
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Online branding activities can save time and reach all levels of society. Nosh Kitchen, a restaurant brand, is active in providing information and branding activities about its restaurant to its consumers through social media. This research aimed to understand the use of Instagram to create Nosh Kitchen's brand equity and find the obstacles and solutions for Nosh Kitchen in creating a strategy to build brand equity through Instagram. This research used a descriptive qualitative method through data collection with observation, in-depth interviews, and documentation. Besides, this research used the analytic data reduction technique of the Miles and Huberman model. The data analysis consists of data reduction, data presentation, and drawing conclusions and verification. The results indicated that Nosh Kitchen had gained its brand awareness on its formative efforts on Instagram. Moreover, Nosh Kitchen has created brand equity efforts by increasing its brand awareness, so that Nosh Kitchen needs to develop a better Instagram social media strategy.

articleTitle: IT Support Model for SMEs to Business Continuity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Single of Indonesian SMEs’ main problem was the dearth of sustainability growth. Furthermost of Indonesian SMEs could not be established to become big corporate. This circumstance directed to a decision that the rising amount of Indonesian had finished up in a impoverishment. This research aims to help SMEs understand the use of information technology to maintain business continuity. The research method uses observation of problems faced by SMEs and information technology solutions to overcome SMEs problems. The results of this study are models of the use of information technology to support SME businesses.

articleTitle: Examining e-Satisfaction During COVID-19: Do Personal Perseverance and Digital Lecturing Skill Matter?
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This paper aims to examine the impact of students’ personal perseverance and digital lecturing skill of lecturers on e-satisfaction as online learning experience in Indonesia university. Cross-sectional study with online questionnaire-based survey was conducted for gathering data. The study has involved about 1,024 students from various state and private universities in Indonesia as respondents. PLS SEM was utilized for analyzing data statistically. The result explains that satisfaction in the online learning experience is determined by digital lecturing skill. Personal perseverance of the students does impact significantly.

articleTitle: Advergame Shopee Tangkap on Shopee’s Brand Personality in Jakarta, Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This study aims to determine and explain the effect of the Shopee Tangkap advergame on the Shopee’s brand personality in Jakarta, Indonesia. The type of research is explanatory research with a quantitative approach. The population studied in this study were residents of DKI Jakarta who used Shopee and had played Shopee Tangkap with a total sample of 100 respondents. The sampling technique used was purposive sampling. The data collection method is done by distributing online questionnaires using Google Forms and analyses with SPSS. The results showed that there was a strong relationship between Shopee Games and Shopee's Brand Personality by obtaining a value of 0.788 in the correlation test. Shopee Games has an influence of 62% on Brand Personality and the remaining 38% is influenced by other factors not researched.

articleTitle: What about Service Quality, Satisfaction, and Loyalty in e-Business? A Systematic Review of Literature
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This article carries out a systematic review of the literature on the topic of service quality, satisfaction, and loyalty in e-business. A total of 27 Scopus based articles, published between 2016 and 2020, have been analyzed. The results are presented with regard to the research contribution to the current study of the correlation between service quality, satisfaction, and loyalty. The objective of this research is to offer an overview of the establishment of service quality research in the last 5 years and fill the gap in broader knowledge about the correlation between service quality, satisfaction, and loyalty so that it can become a basis for researchers to perform future study on the topic.

articleTitle: Geographical Information System Model and MODIS Satellite for Define Fishing Zones
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Most of Indonesia's territory is sea, but based on fishery and marine data, there are several areas in Indonesia where capture fisheries production has decreased in recent years which has an impact on fishermen's income. Many factors can be done to increase capture fisheries production, one of which is to determine the potential of the fishing zone by combining GIS with MODUS satellite. The purpose of this research is to help the government and fishermen determine fish catch zones to increase fishermen's income. The result of this research is a geographical information model with MODUS satellite to help fishermen determine potential fish catch zones.

articleTitle: Private E-Marketplace Model for SMEs
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: SMEs are recognized as part of the nation's economy and the contribution of SMEs to employment and building a populist economy has been proven in several studies. However, there are many limitations faced by SMEs where currently many SMEs cannot survive and close their businesses. One of the factors that hinders the development of SMEs is the inability of SMEs to compete so that SMEs products do not sell well in the market. The research method uses a qualitative approach by conducting observations and discussions about selling via e-marketplace for SMEs. This study aims to help SMEs sell their products in the SME community market so that competitive SME products are limited to SME products in one community. The result of this research is a private e-marketplace model for SMEs.

articleTitle: Designing P2P Lending System through Enterprise Architecture Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Developing Peer to Peer (P2P) lending system is important for lending business company. Based on business needs that are increasingly developing in the future and most of companies do not yet have enterprise architecture to manage information technology in running a business. The P2P Lending Company requires design technology architecture to improve harmony between uses technology and business. On this paper, author try to analyze and design technology architecture at This P2P Lending Company using the TOGAF ADM framework. TOGAF ADM used as a framework in this study because it has been in accordance with the development of architecture at the enterprise level. This research resulted blueprint technology architecture document. The Blueprint can be used as a reference or basis for development technology at all P2P Lending Company which Registered in Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) as needed business.

articleTitle: Analysis of The Effectiveness Of Social Media Instagram (A Case Study at Pom-Pom Café)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Social media has become an important part of a business to promote products and communicate with the customers. However, there are still many businessmen don't know what factors influence and what to do to attract attention of customers. They just post or upload content on social media without a strategy. Therefore, the contribution of this research is to outline the best practices to improve engagement on a Food and Beverage (FnB) business account. The process includes collecting competitor’s data both their business development in the field and Instagram account statistical data, conducting data comparisons, and assessing competitors' content posting activities. We use a local business account as a case study for this research practice at pom-pom cafe. It found that the activeness of posting content on social media accounts can attract audience interest. In addition, good visuals and appropriate language used according to market segments will attract audience attention and interaction.

articleTitle: Comparing Two Heuristics in a Vehicle Routing Problem – using a Case Study in a Paint Manufacturer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Vehicle Routing Problem is one of the classical NP-hard operation research problem. Its application is diverse in industry since transportation cost is one of the major elements in firms’ logistic. The study is a case study in a paint manufacturer wish to optimize the scheduling of its paint delivery at one of the branches in suburb of Jakarta. The study compared two heuristic of VRP, namely using combination of agglomerative hierarchical clustering and visual weight routing and Large Neighborhood Search algorithm using an open source VRP Solver spreadsheet developed at Bath University. The result showed the LNS algorithm is superior by around 20% in reducing the variable cost, although in term of total cost only get 4% cost saving for the studied company. Nevertheless, the combination of AHC and visual weight routing is more intuitive and simpler to be understood.

articleTitle: Application Model of Small-Scale Hotel Room Rates Prediction in South Jakarta Using Business Analytics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Prior to the Covid-19 pandemic, there are many small three-star hotels in South Jakarta experienced difficulties in overcoming declining revenues due to increasing competition in terms of room rates, demand for more facilities, and the growth of guest houses as an alternative option factor for customers. The aim of this research is to evaluate and design a system for RAL Hotels or similar, which may be used by General Managers and Operational Managers to obtain information on hotel room rates prediction for each of their client segments. Analysis of the competitive forces of Porter, Value Shop analysis, Fishbone analysis, SWOT analysis and Multi Linear Regression analysis were carried out for plotting data from several years ago and knowing its trends in the future. The results obtained are to know more precisely the root of the problem, the direction of the business strategy for the next few years, and the design of an application system that can help provide information about room rates predictions.

articleTitle: Product Guarantee as a Determining Intention to Purchase Fashion in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Retailers who provide guarantee policies for fashion products can foster a high sense of trust and purchase intention. This study examines the effect of retailers' guarantee policies on fashion products' purchase intention with trust as a mediator.
