The research method used is descriptive qualitative with primary data collection carried out through semi-structured interviews with five representatives of five cyber media. Secondary data collection is done by observing the news broadcast in the five cyber media which is the object of research. The data analysis technique used six stages of analysis developed by Creswell. There are four findings in this study as a form of Google-controlled journalism in the work process of cyber media journalism in Indonesia. The four findings are 1) The colonialization of cyber media by Google. 2) Google through AdSense influences the business model and the development of clickbait in cyber media journalism. 3) "What Google Said" as the new news value and news distribution reference. 4) The development of Google's journalism mindset in writing news, namely writing based on keywords.

articleTitle: Usage Evaluation of Beauty E-Commerce with Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This study aims to evaluate the usage of e-commerce of beauty products. The variables that are used for this study are those derived from the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) model. The UTAUT model in this study was expanded with the addition of three variables based on previous research, namely trust on the internet (TI), product performance risk (PPR), and situational effects (STI). The data used in this study were obtained by a questionnaire and analyzed using the PLS-SEM technique. The results obtained from this study indicate that the factor effort expectancy, social influence, and product performance risk have a significant effect on Behavioral Intention and Behavioral Intention also have effect on Use Behavior. Meanwhile, other factors, namely performance expectancy, trust on the internet, and situational influence have no effect on behavioral intention and facilitating conditions also have no effect on use behavior.

articleTitle: The Employees Survey of Enterprise Resources Planning System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: ERP solutions have evolved over the years, and many are now typically web-based applications that users can access remotely. However, an ERP system can be ineffective if a company doesn't implement it carefully. The focus of this research is to describe how opinions, emotional intelligence situations, motivations and what types of training are applied in the company to make sure the ERP implementation process runs properly. The method used in this study is a survey method by distributing questionnaires, but it is not processed through statistics because it does not intend to test hypotheses. Questionnaires were given to respondents using close ended questions to get answers from respondents. The data collection also through interviews with Chairperson and HRD Manager where the research was conducted. The Result show that the Benefits and Function of ERP are accepted by employees who are supported by their high emotional intelligence. The Chairperson was satisfied with using ERP. Training can provide a change in mindset can provide permanent change and does not require expensive costs for implementation. The conclusion was that the ERP system agreed to support employees work, even though the first time they feel difficult to deal with the system. Coaching on employees that encourage employees can adaptation to the use of ERP. The Training must support the company's beliefs, attitudes, and values.

articleTitle: Comparison of Continuance Intention in Using E-Wallet among Indonesian Gen X, Y, and Z
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: In the midst of the Covid-19 pandemic and intense market competition, e-wallet players need to stop only relying on sales promotions to retain their users and start switching to a more sustainable strategy to produce Continuance Intention of gen X, Y, and Z consumers as the largest number of users. The purposes of this study are to determine whether there is any difference in Continuance Intention among gen X, Y, and Z consumers in using e-wallet, to prove the influence of antecedent variables toward Continuance Intention, and whether there are differences in those antecedent variables among gen X, Y, and Z consumers in using e-wallet. Research data obtained by distributing questionnaire to 200 respondents then analyzed using ANOVA, Multiple Linear Regression, and MANOVA. The results indicate that there is a difference on Continuance Intention among gen X, Y and Z; Perceived Value, Perceived Enjoyment, Personal Innovation, Switching Cost, and Habit simultaneously influence Continuance Intention; and specifically there are differences on Personal Innovation and Habit among gen X, Y, and Z.

articleTitle: Social Networking Application of International Students on Fighting Culture Shock During Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This study is describing the social networking application that has been used by international students both in Indonesia and USA, since the online culture increasingly implemented and becomes a familiar habit amidst the pandemic. It has accelerated to the point of becoming a ubiquitous part of the modern living recently. Living in a new culture enforce people to adjust their behavioral system for their own existence and harmonious life, therefore they will be experienced the culture shock in facing the new way of life due to COVID–19. The aim is to describe how the social networking application becomes a tool in helping people on fighting the culture shock in this pandemic era. In this regard the constructivist paradigm was carried out to describes the phenomenon on Instagram as social network application. The qualitative methods were used to collect data by virtual participant observation and online interviews via Zoom meetings. The results point out to communication through social networking apps becomes a new way to help them understand and keeping up with the new world after COVID-19, for it helped them also fight the culture shock. The people who is familiar with it becomes more ready to face the changes. The conclusion shows whether the pandemic is accelerating innovation in the telecommunication sector, creating new challenges for educators, communication industry, and professionals regarding the social networking applications used.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Study and Systematic Literature Review of Blockchain Technology in Vehicle Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The application of blockchain technology to the vehicle industry is one of the implementations applied to improve the company system performance with customer relationship management (CRM) and supply chain management (SCM). Research in this field is scarce, so this research aims to analyze and synthesize research topic trends, a part of research related to the advancement of blockchain technology in the vehicle industry. The method used in this research is a systematic literature review and bibliometric using Publish and Perish software and analysis with VOSviewer software. The keywords used are blockchain technology, vehicle, automotive, and the vehicle industry. Based on the findings, there are 40 relevant papers, and there are trends that occur in research in this field, starting from 2017 to the present. Trending topics is data, application, supply chain, feasibility, transparency, traceability, integrity, car, privacy, business, ledger, information, smart contracts, internet, and manufacturing. This research provides perspective and trending topics on blockchain in the vehicle industry.

articleTitle: Towards Digital Equality: Assessing Youths’ Digital Literacy Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Indonesia has ranked fourth in the country with the most internet users in the world as of December 2019. However, even with the big number of internet users, there is still a gap even with rapid internet penetration in the country. This modern gap separates between digital literate and digital illiterate. While internet users are predominantly youths, they are not automatically digital literate. Therefore, this study aims to measure the digital literacy index among youths, and further analyze digital skills based on various demographic variables. This research used a quantitative approach through statistical analysis. Data was collected through online surveys with a total response of 428 participants. The population of this study is youths between 17 and 24 years old and live in Jakarta and Yogyakarta. The result shows that participants’ digital literacy index reach 4.24 out of 5. Older participants also have higher digital skills than younger peers. There are no significant differences between male and female participants, although female adolescents have a slightly higher index. Lastly, participants with lower monthly expenses have a lower digital literacy index.

articleTitle: Analysis of Digital Marketing Activities on Instagram Social Media with Coffee Shop Business Objects in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The growth in size of coffee shops in Indonesia, makes people do not recognize the coffee shop brand that exists. Therefore, it is important for business to build brand awareness so that it is better known by the public. With the rapid development social media today, many coffee shops are using social media to attract consumers and market their products. The goal of this research is to describe brand awareness on Instagram social media in the coffee shop business. Secondly to describe does social media the coffee shop brand has maintained customer relationships through its content on social media and the last one is by giving recommendation to a coffee shop for using digital marketing strategy. This research uses Secondary Data and Content Analysis methods to collect all the data needed. Author can conclude that digital marketing is very important moreover when running a coffee shop business, for that coffee shop can build their brand awareness. Author recommendations are post content every day, utilize the Instagram Story feature and Highlight, using general hashtag, and do collaboration. The data that author been analyze every top local coffee shop in Indonesia already had their own marketing strategy in social media however their engagement that they obtained still low.

articleTitle: Influences of EWOM in Social Media on Consumer's Purchase Intention on Online Video Streaming
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Electronic Word of Mouth (eWOM) is considered as one of marketing tools moreover in the digital business environment like online video streaming. This research investigates how eWOM can influence consumer’s purchase intention with online video streaming. The conceptual framework developed with the IAM by considering eWOM quality, eWOM quantity, eWOM credibility, Needs of information, Information usefulness, Information adoption and Purchase intention. Based on questionnaires collected from 163 respondent’s eWOM quality, eWOM credibility, and Needs of Information are proven to influence information usefulness and finally influence the purchase intention even though eWOM quantity is not influential.

articleTitle: Smart Village Design using Enterprise Architecture Framework Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This paper describes the design of smart village that can be describe as an indicator for the smart village in Indonesia, where the Indonesian population is now more than 250 million peoples. with several islands as much as 17,504 islands, consisting of 53.3% were in urban areas, the rest spread in rural areas, but it will turn around if there is no solution currently to address the disparity in the village in terms of infrastructure and technology. One of the concepts can be applied to overcome these problems is "Smart Village". Conducting a study of four villages on the island of Java in Indonesia, which was awarded the village of Information Technology, the study aims to research the indicators that make the village as the village of Information Technology. By using the TOGAF Enterprise Architecture analysis, the result of study are the components that exist in the ICT village winners and what the other components needs to complement the design of smart village which can be a reference in Indonesia in future.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Supply Chain Management in the N95 Respirator Product by using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: As it starts at the end of the year 2019, the Covid-19 pandemic has already disturbed the condition of human life, socio-culture, and economics globally. As the virus is spreading from human to human, the need for a respirator mask is critical. One very well-known respirator mask is N95. The huge demand and high price of the N95 respirator effect create a bogus mask. This study proposes using blockchain in a global implementation of supply chain management of N95 respirator supply chain activity. Blockchain systems may help to reduce people's worldwide anxiety about the spread of N95 respirator counterfeits. The method used in this research is a systematic literature review and proposing a blockchain framework base on blockchain components. The implementation can use RFID at the level of manufacturers, distributors, and sellers. Using QR code or RFID stickers are possible in the level of customers or buyers. The result of this research is a proposal of blockchain technology for N95 respirator supply chain management systems, N95 respirator supply chain activities workflow, and a use case diagram.

articleTitle: Mapping of Digital Innovation Research Themes: A 36-Year Review
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Research on digital innovation with an entrepreneurial spirit continues to develop but is limited to one country and/or one field. From a bibliometric review, this study purpose to visually study mapping and research trends in the field of digital innovation on an international scale. This study used bibliometric techniques with secondary data from Scopus. Analyze and visualize data using the VOSViewer program and the analyze search results function on Scopus. This study analyzed 821 academic documents published from 1983 to 2019. According to the research, the Universitetet I Oslo and Henfridsson, O. had the most active affiliated institutions and individual scientists in digital innovation research. Computer science was the most studied of digital innovation. Based on the identification of a collection of knowledge accumulated from over thirty-six years of publication, this research proposes a grouping of digital innovation research themes: Health Care, Internet of Things, Conceptual Framework, Open System, Digital Platforms, Education, abbreviated as HICODE research themes.

articleTitle: Exploration of Software Implementation on Cloud Accounting and Security System Towards Accounting Practices Case Study from A Private Company in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Cloud accounting is an innovation in accounting development that acts as a form of ERP system combined with cloud computing in software as a service. This study aims to explore the benefits and risks due to the adoption of the system in corporate accounting practices. Especially in the security system and compliance with applicable accounting policies. The study was conducted with qualitative research methods with descriptive approach. Data collection techniques are done by interview, observation, and literature study. This research uses the TOE framework and the characteristics of Parkerian Hexad to explore the risks and benefits of implementing cloud accounting systems in companies both in terms of data confidentiality and economic security. Research shows that using cloud accounting simplifies the accounting process. and the output and application are in accordance with the applicable policies.

articleTitle: Indonesian Millennial Segmentation to Increase Customer Retention in Using Online Grocery Apps
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: As Indonesian millennials become more familiar in purchasing products online, it also encourages the purchase of groceries to be done online. Although most millennials have used online grocery apps, but the retention is still low. The purpose of this research is to confirm the influence of customer retention antecedents to the customer retention in using online grocery apps, to identify millennial segmentation based on customer retention antecedents in using online grocery apps, and to test whether there are differences among the segments. To answer the research objectives, questionnaire is distributed to 200 millennials using simple random sampling technique. Linear regression, cluster analysis, cross-tabulation, and multiple discriminant analysis are used as analysis methods in this research. The results show that all independent variables significantly affect customer retention; with all those customer retention driving factors, four millennial segments in online grocery apps can be identified, namely Youngster Millennial, Trust Oriented Mid-Millennial, Productive Millennial, and Tech Savvy Millennial; and a significant difference is proven among those four segments with Perceived Security, Perceived Privacy, and Convenience as the most dominant differentiating factors.

articleTitle: Management Information Systems for International Students in Indonesia and United States during Covid-19 in 2020
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to provide an overview of management information systems relates to international students in Indonesia and the US during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020. The Management Information Systems touched interpersonal communication between persons equipped with technology. Primary data collection techniques using interviews through the Zoom application revealed that communication through technology was essential during the COVID-19 epidemic. The results of the discussion showed that there was no significant change in management information systems in the learning processes of students in the two countries. One issue that was found, was adjusting to each other's time zones. The student interaction protocol with the campus has followed the rules set by the campus without exception. While some students required assistance with digital technology, the students feel support to use information systems because they already knew the conditions through the campus website that had been prepared.

articleTitle: Factors that Affecting the Use of E-Commerce in Online Fashion Product Purchases (Case Study XYZ E-Commerce)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to identify the factors that influence the intention to use XYZ e-commerce to buy fashion products online. In particular we are interested in examining the influence of variables such as performance expectancy (PE), effort expectancy (EE), social influence (SI), and facilitating conditions (FC) on behavioral intention to use (BIU). The research model is based on the UTAUT model. Thus, it is a quantitative study where the data are collected by distributing questionnaires using google form targeting the XYZ’s users in Jabodetabek area. The model is formulated as a structural equation modelling (SEM) and SMART PLS is chosen as tool to analysis the data. The result of this study showed that performance expectancy (PE) and social influence (SI) have a significant influence on behavioral intention to use. Meanwhile, effort expectancy (EE) and facilitating conditions (FC) does not have significant influence on behavioral intention to use.

Author Keywords: unified theory of acceptance and use of technology (UTAUT)

articleTitle: Cross-Cultural Communication in Micro/Small/Medium Enterprises Business by Using Social Media
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The improvement of micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) have become the government's priority in efforts to increase the national economy. This research was focusing on how MSMEs could learn from cross-cultural communication to improve their businesses while using social media. This research used a qualitative approach to describe certain social conditions in accordance with the purpose. The data was analyzed thoroughly, it showed that cross-cultural communication supported MSMEs in using social media to improve more if they were willingly to open their mind and learn from others. Referring to the previous quantitative research, that discussed about the characteristics of successful businessmen/women with high enthusiasm could be seen from their ability to innovate and tolerate diversity according to the survey conducted. Informants were using all means of communication such as social media, messaging apps and old fashion verbal or written communication. They learnt a lot when doing social media communication with people from different countries and cultures and could make the differences as their strengths in business.

articleTitle: Technology Disruption and Teacher’s Motivation in Online Classes: Case Study XYZ School during COVID-19 Pandemic in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: COVID-19 that hit Indonesia quite hard pushed more than 68 million students and around 4 million teachers to move their teaching and learning online. Technology disruptions couldn't be avoided, and they could be in the form of the connection and other things such as class preparation and management. The new form of learning caused quite some hassle that pushed teachers and students to cooperate and adapt to it. Teachers have a hard time motivating their students to keep going and keep their learning spirit. This, however, caused teachers to spend extra time preparing for materials, searching for the best class management method also affecting their teaching motivation and spirit. This research tries to determine how technology disruptions during online classes could affect teachers' teaching motivation and spirit also what could be the possible causes. The qualitative approach with the case study method is conducted by doing an in-depth interview with four experienced teachers using purposive sampling and comparing the result with previous research. This study found that online class is quite a time consuming and it's pretty challenging to do the class management, especially in big classes. Lack of human presence and direct interaction also affect teacher's motivation during teaching online. However, it only affects their motivation on a particular task instead of the basis of being a teacher itself.

articleTitle: Smart Cities in Indonesia: A Retrospective of the Publication Journey
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Research on smart cities in Indonesia continues to develop but is limited to one field and/or one year. From the retrospective journey of bibliometric analysis, this study purposes to visually research mapping and research trends in international publications on smart cities in Indonesia. This study used bibliometric techniques with secondary data from Scopus. Analyze and visualize data using the VOSViewer program and the analyze search results function on Scopus. This study analyzed 518 scientific documents published from 2013 to 2020. According to the research, Universitas Indonesia, and Suhono Harso Supangkat had the most active affiliated organization and individual scientists in smart cities publications from Indonesia. Computer Science, and IOP Conference Series Earth and Environmental Science were the most studied and disseminated outlets of smart cities publication. There were three category maps of collaborative researchers. Based on the identification of a collection of knowledge accumulated from over seven years of publication, this research proposes a grouping of smart cities publication themes in Indonesia: Government, Living, Information management, Intelligent system, Mobility, and Environment, abbreviated as GLIIME publication themes.

articleTitle: Analysis of Employee and Manager Self Service Module on SAP Portal (A Case Study Approach)
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Human resources are knowledge, skill, and abilities that make humans the capital or assets of a company. If a company has employees as highly competent assets, the company will benefit more. This is based on the fact that by assuming employees as capital who have the knowledge, expertise, and skills that are qualified, humans who work in a company can run other resources. The purpose of this research is to evaluate the attainment of the SAP ESS MSS Portal features in Bank XYZ specifically in Human Capital Management Module. expected benefits to be gained of this research is to help company know the level of suitability and gaps that might be identified in the features that are evaluated in SAP ERP time management and training and event management submodule. methods that are used to gather data in this research includes interview, questionnaire, and observation. from the data gathered, fit-gap analysis is conducted in order to find problems that might existed on the system. the final result that are obtained from this research are recommendations for the system development such as new the user interface and flow of the activities executed during operating the system and calculation of the cost of business activities / processes before and after system development by making costing matrix. It is concluded that the proposed functions enables company to save both time and costs needed to perform related activities.

articleTitle: Creative Learning Media for High-Functioning Autistic Student Using Video Sharing Platform during the Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: This research is motivated by pandemic condition that has implications for the transformation of learning. Previously learning course was held face to face in offline class. However, currently rely more on online learning media. This study analyzes the importance of learning media for students with special needs, especially in the HFA (High-Functioning Autistic) category. This research uses Cognitive Theory of Multimedia Learning and data collection using mix methods both qualitative and quantitative research, as well as exploring advanced analytical from the video sharing platform specifically provided for HFA students. This study shows that learning media using YouTube for HFA students is considered to be effective. This learning medium is easy to use and can be played repeatedly as a tutorial, videos help in practical assignments. Also there is a subscribe feature which can be utilized to remind the advanced materials or links to the previous learning materials. This study also shows the beneficial potential of YouTube as a learning medium as an application that is familiar to be used by students.

articleTitle: The Exploring of Traditional Music by Elementary School Age in The Web Tourism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Tourism industry is predicted to squirm again after the public can overcome the Corona Virus outbreak in 2019 with vaccinations and other efforts. The purpose of this study is to describe how the children exploring of traditional music in tourism web. The method of research conducted is experiential, interviews and observations that are equipped with literature reviews. The conclusion said that experiential of exploring traditional music on the "Better Go-Now" website by elementary school-age children showed that the five elements of the spectrum offered in the country's tourism destinations are less illustrated through traditional music. The Performance of the "Better Go-Now" website proved that the external appearance has managed to attract the attention of visitors. However, video content posted by the web does not strengthen the brand.

articleTitle: The Impact of IT on Changing Business Models in Government Services: A Case Study of The Investment Board and One Stop Service in Jakarta
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Digital government is imperative to public service in this era. Having digital services is now inherent in government forward facing offering to citizen. The use of website and mobile application in providing service to citizens have impact to business model/mission model of the government agency. This paper elaborates the impact of IT to mission model in The Investment Board and One Stop Service (DPMPTSP) DKI Jakarta to give better service to its citizens and business owners. The use of the principles of public service in industry 4.0 and IT-enabled services has brought the use of website and mobile application to manage citizen’s personal and business permits/non-permits to be evaluated against DPMPTSP’s strategy. DPMPTSP business model/mission model has changed from manual process to process redesign enabled using IT, namely Service Website and JakEVO. The research methodology to be adopted for this research will be a qualitative method accordance with the information and data from sources, and the evidence related to change that have been made. The result of this research is DPMPTSP services has become simpler, faster, and streamlined because of the use of IT-enable services, increases the number of applicants applying for permits and non-permits, and increase tax revenues collected from retribution fees permits and non-permits.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effect of Benefit and Trust to the Intention Using Mobile Payment and Its Impact on Positive WOM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The objective of this study was to determine the effect of benefits and trust on the intention to use mobile payment and its impact on positive WOM in the DKI Jakarta area. Primary data were obtained from questionnaires that 400 respondents answered in the Jakarta area. Data analysis techniques using Structure Equation Modeling with software LISREL 8.7. This study indicates the benefit of using mobile payments, continuance intention, intention to recommend, and trust in using mobile payments.

articleTitle: Study on the Implementation of Tourism Website Collaboration in the Promotion and Marketing of Bangka Belitung Province
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: In general, tourism promotion and marketing have been carried out by tourism businesses through their respective websites separately so that it may result in less than the optimal provision of information to prospective tourists, both domestic and foreign. These websites can collaborate so that they can further support increased promotion and marketing. This paper aims to examine whether the implementation of the concept of tourism website collaboration in Bangka Belitung Province can be implemented both technically, organizationally, and economically. The method used is the study of provincial tourism regulatory documents, online marketing promotion surveys, and literature studies on the stages of system development, especially on the implementation stage. The results obtained are the implementation of the provincial-level tourism website collaboration concept, technology, and operational organizations can be implemented and the business actors in the tourism sector have an opportunity to increase their services and profits.

articleTitle: Examining The Antecedents of Electronic Loyalty In Fashion E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Building and managing customer loyalty who buy fashion by e-commerce platforms is the key to making a profit. This research aims to explain the effect of electronic service quality and electronic word-of-mouth on electronic loyalty with electronic satisfaction and electronic trust as intervening. The research method used is verification with a sample of 400 consumers who have done fashion shopping by e-commerce platforms in the Jakarta, Depok, Tangerang, and Bekasi areas, so we apply the purposive sampling method. Data analysis used CB-SEM with LISREL 8.71. The results report that electronic service quality and electronic word-of-mouth positively and significantly impact electronic loyalty and indirectly through electronic satisfaction and electronic trust. The research outcomes become input for e-commerce fashion businesses to make decisions to keep and increase electronic loyalty.

articleTitle: The Role of Location-based Augmented Reality in Enhancing Visit Intention of Cultural Heritage Site
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Applications based on Augmented Reality are increasingly adopted by various industries, primarily when supported by smartphones and tablets. The purpose of this study is to examine the role of location-based augmented reality in better presenting a cultural heritage site. To meet the objectives of the study, the authors distributed surveys and conducted interviews (100 respondents from the museum were involved in the inquiry). Descriptive statistics were employed to assess the quantitative descriptions of participants’ responses. The result is the proposed BataviAR application to assist visitors in having informal learning at the historic site of Jakarta Old Town and enhance the tourists’ experience by displaying directions in simplified searching. Although these applications are often little more than experimental prototypes, AR technology is proving highly flexible and is showing great potential in numerous areas and industrial sectors, and they will become even more widespread in the near future.

articleTitle: Digital Marketing in Fashion Industries within Indonesia and Thailand as Cross-Cultural Communication to Support Start-Up Societies
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The purpose of this research was to conduct how digital marketing in fashion industry within Indonesia and Thailand as Cross-Cultural Communication to support start up society. This study used a descriptive qualitative approach to describe systematically and specifically the facts or characteristics of the situation, social settings, or certain relationships, both in the form of conditions, problems, attitudes, opinions, conditions, procedures, or systems factually and meticulously. In this research, the seven informants from startup society were observed and interviewed. The informants were chosen because of their background experiences, competencies, and credibility in fashion industry. The research result showed In the Pandemics situation, the seller in Indonesia used digital platform for marketing activities. They familiar with shop owners in Bangkok, they often get the latest fashion photos, so they have the first chance to post in their digital shop. However, in the pandemic situation platform digital help them for the trading activities. Muslim fashion, Indonesia has a more updated designer compared to Thailand so that cooperation between Indonesia and Thailand is expected to become a synergy. All transaction is dominant with digital transaction that safe for buyer, and seller.

articleTitle: Data Classification Techniques for Disease Symptoms Detection: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: Data classification techniques are very useful for disease symptoms detection. Doctor and medical personnel need a software that can help treat patients. When developing software for diagnose disease, it must choose data classification techniques based on disease that will be diagnose. The failure of choose data classification techniques, it may disease diagnose inaccurately. Software developer team must know data classification techniques for disease symptoms detection. With data classification techniques, it can ease doctor and medical personnel in disease diagnosis. There are some factors that affect to choose the best data classification method based on disease diagnose are information, detection, prevention, and management of disease including fraud in health insurance. It must find the best data classification techniques when they develop an application for diagnose disease. Data classification techniques must have intense of usefulness and analyze data accurately. The aim of this paper to review data classification techniques, data classification techniques process run, the used of data classification and factors that influencing when choose data classification techniques based on disease. This paper will give benefits to doctor and medical personnel and software developer team to understand about data classification techniques for disease diagnosis and also they can build an application that can detect disease accurately. The content of this paper are data classification definition, data classification run process and data classification usability.

articleTitle: The Role of Capital and Investment Enterprise Resource Planning on Financial Accounting in Developing Countries: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: There is a growing need to incorporate a complete business approach that serves all main business functions. ERP program, which is intended to satisfy this requirement, has been commonly adopted by organizations in developing countries. Meanwhile, ERP is becoming more prevalent in many developing-country companies. According to our findings, ERP technology in developing countries faces additional challenges due to fiscal, cultural, and critical infrastructure issues. By comparing advanced and developing nations, this paper identifies a variety of concerns surrounding ERP investment. The paper drawn conclusions about good and bad practices of capital investment ERP on Financial Accounting in developing countries, so that company can considerate the use and implementation of ERP systems.

articleTitle: Comparison of Farmers' Experience in Indonesia on HCI
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Information Management and Technology (ICIMTech)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to describe a comparison of the situation of farmers in three regions in Indonesia on human computer interaction (HCI). With the results of this study, it can be mapped how to communicate with them. This research method uses qualitatvie method with primary data collection through interviews to farmers in Bangil, Lembang and Manado, equipped through the observation, and literature review. The results showed in general, they feel unfamiliar with information technology. In Bangil area, the average age of farmers is elderly, so it is very rare on HCI. In Lembang, many farmers are millennial so HCI is most relevant. Manado farmers, half are on HCI and the other half do not touch HCI. The conclusion of this study, the location and age of farmers determine the level on HCI in their agricultural activities.
